title: Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 for Weyl algebras: Lean 4 formalization
description: Lean 4 formalization of Stafford's Conjecture 3.8 over every characteristic-zero field. The original Challenge states existence of F, R, S with 1 = dR + FdS for nonzero d in every Weyl rank, including rank zero. The additional exact-source Challenge states the manuscript strengthening in positive rank: F is a linear symplectic coordinate raised to the intrinsic Bernstein degree of d. The proof account records the visible-divisor-frame and finite-gradient conormal-axis route actually used by the terminal proof; the separately proved tangent-limit theorem is auxiliary. The repository includes both Challenge/Solution pairs, their Comparator configurations, a proof map and Challenge dossier, consumer checks, and exact verification records. Verification scope and permitted foundational axioms are recorded in docs/verification.md. This release adds the manuscript cyclicity and noncharacteristic corollaries with independent consumers and source-to-paper correspondence checks. The existing Palomar record certifies its registered headline theorem; later archive additions are checked locally and do not imply a new Palomar registration. The manuscript audit snapshot, bibliography and historical workflow protocols are included for source correspondence; manuscript material retains CC BY 4.0 as stated in its nested license. Version 1.2.1 exposes the paper generator x-yF and the canonical initial-ideal base-change equality as checked declarations; the whole current paper correspondence is reviewable, with the printed tangent-lattice construction explicitly not yet certified as a route.
notes: Kernel-checked Lean proof. Independent human expert review of the mathematics and the accompanying manuscript are separate; see docs/verification.md for the exact scope of the machine check.
